description.value:
Identity is a toolkit. So is hope.

You maintain a cache of prepared personas—faces, voices, and micro-histories.

  • You can keep a number of personas equal to your tier “ready to run” at any given time, each with a name, demeanor, and short cover story.
  • During a Courtly Intrigue, infiltration, or social scene, you may spend 1 Soft Power OP to switch into one of your cached personas as a bonus action.
  • When you do, you gain advantage on your next Stealth (Intrigue) or Diplomacy (Presence) check in that scene.

Personas do not grant mechanical disguises by themselves, but stack with mundane or magical disguise as the table allows.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Persona Cache
Recovery: Per-scene swap (1 Soft Power OP)  ·  Action: Bonus action  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Maintain `tier` cached personas (name, demeanor, short cover). In a Courtly Intrigue / infiltration / social scene, spend 1 Soft Power OP to swap into a cached persona; reroll the lowest die on your next Stealth (Intrigue/Presence) or Diplomacy (Presence) check that scene.

system.requirements: Dreamwalker 3, Trance of the Thousand Faces
